_readme: THE CONTRACT: everything RGA checks when a client onboards. Built 2026-09-05.
Chris: 'when we do onboarding do we do a deep dive scan of website and document current state and
then the recommended and fixes plan... audit GBP, website, maybe social media, list all things we
🔑 WHY A SPEC FILE AND NOT JUST CODE: an audit that lives only in code has no way to say what it
does NOT check. Every gap is invisible. This file lists the complete intended surface, and each
item declares its own automation status - so `audit-coverage.mjs` can report honestly that we
cover N of M, rather than a green tick implying completeness we do not have.
🔴 `status` is the load-bearing field. Never mark an item `automated` because a task id exists -
only when a function actually produces the value. A field that exists is not data.
status: automated = code produces it | manual = a human does it | gap = neither, yet
weight:  ranking leverage, 1-5. 5 = named by research as a top factor.
source:  where the benchmark or justification comes from (config/industry-benchmarks.json keys,
or 'rga-almanac' for our own observed data, or 'observed' for direct measurement).

gbp.label: Google Business Profile
gbp.why: 32% of local ranking weight (whitespark_lsrf_2026) — the single highest-leverage surface we control. Proximity outranks it at 55% but cannot be changed.

checks.label: Primary category is the best available match
checks.note: 🔴 Highest-leverage single field in local SEO. Cross-reference the dominant top-3 category for this vertical in rga-almanac — if the client's differs from what actually ranks, that IS the finding.

checks.label: Secondary categories present and accurate
checks.note: Only categories the business genuinely serves. A stretch category brings wrong leads, not more leads.

checks.label: Description ≥500 chars, leads with service + city
Photo count and recency
checks.note: Behavioural/engagement signals are climbing year over year.

checks.label: Listing is verified
checks.note: An unverified listing cannot rank. Check this FIRST — every other GBP item is wasted effort until it passes.

checks.label: Review count vs the vertical's top-3 median
checks.note: 🔑 OUR DIFFERENTIATOR. Aggregates vertical_benchmarks (one row per search TERM) and applies the ≥30-business/≥3-city bar. 🔴 Below the bar it reports 'not enough data', never a median. ✅ review_count/rating now stored daily by refresh-review-metrics via Places Details + google_place_id, as an append-only TIME SERIES (velocity is weighted above raw count). PROVEN: a plumbers-vertical client with 0 reviews reports '0 vs top-3 median 237 (n=50 across 6 cities), gap of 237'.

checks.label: Rating vs vertical median
checks.note: 31% of consumers will only use a business rated 4.5+ (brightlocal_lcrs_2026). Same publish-bar and stored-value caveats as gbp.review_count.

checks.label: New reviews per month
checks.note: Velocity is weighted above raw count.

checks.label: Owner responses to reviews
checks.note: 🔴 50% of consumers reject copy-paste replies — response QUALITY, not just rate.

checks.label: View-to-action rate vs the 4.8% SMB benchmark
checks.note: Below 3% needs work; above 7% is outperforming. Compare to the client's VERTICAL, not the global mean.

website.label: Website
website.why: 19% of ranking weight (whitespark_lsrf_2026), and it is where the conversion happens after the map pack does its job.

checks.label: Schema VALIDATES and its NAP matches GBP
checks.note: 🔴 Presence is not correctness — schema with the wrong phone actively contradicts the GBP.

checks.label: Name/address/phone on site match GBP exactly
checks.note: A mismatch between the site and the listing undermines both. INDETERMINATE without a connected GBP — it is the source of truth.

checks.label: Contact form present and submitting
checks.note: ⚠️ Detects a <form> tag only — it does NOT prove submission works. Genuine end-to-end test is a gap.

checks.label: LCP / CLS / TBT and mobile performance score
A page exists per service sold
checks.note: 🔴 Homepage-only audits miss this entirely. Today we fetch the homepage and nothing else.

checks.label: Pages targeting each service-area city
checks.note: RGA's own GSC showed Pasadena demand with no page targeting it — the exact gap this catches.

search_presence.label: Search presence (GSC + GA4)
search_presence.why: The only source that shows what Google ALREADY associates with this business. 🔴 Read this BEFORE choosing a keyword to optimise for — skipping it is how RGA tracked a term it had zero impressions for, for five weeks.

checks.label: Position 8–25 terms with real demand
checks.note: Highest-ROI work available — already relevant, one push from page 1.

checks.label: High-impression, zero-click terms
checks.note: Visible to Google, invisible to buyers.

checks.label: Branded vs non-branded demand
checks.note: Mostly-branded traffic means discovery is not happening — a very different problem from poor ranking.

checks.label: Conversion events actually configured
checks.note: 🔴 GA4 returning zero conversions may mean none are CONFIGURED, not that none happened. Distinguish before reporting.

maps_rank.label: Maps rankings (geo-grid)
maps_rank.why: The outcome measure. Everything else is a lever; this is the needle.

checks.label: Tracked keyword has real GSC impressions
checks.note: 🔴🔴 Runs as m1.audit.keyword_validation, and m1.audit.grid_baseline now dependsOn it. Tracking a term Google never shows the business for produces a uniform not-found grid that looks like data. Proven: RGA old keyword = 3 impressions/90d, new = 1276. See project_rank_grid_uniform_sentinel.

checks.label: Their review counts / categories vs the client
checks.note: Turns 'you rank 12th' into 'they hold 3x your reviews and a category you are missing'.

citations.label: Citations / NAP
citations.why: Consistency across the web corroborates the listing.

checks.label: NAP identical across citations we hold URLs for
checks.note: 🔴 Only for URLs WE HOLD (site links + schema sameAs). Discovery needs a paid aggregator — 'not found' means we hold no URL, NEVER 'no citation exists'. Directories blocking datacentre IPs return INDETERMINATE, not broken.

checks.label: No duplicate/competing listings
checks.note: A duplicate listing splits ranking signals and is a common silent killer. 🔴 NOT buildable without a citation aggregator (Whitespark/BrightLocal/Yext) — detecting a duplicate requires discovering listings we hold no URL for.

checks.label: Site links to its own directory profiles
checks.note: 🔑 The one fully VERIFIABLE finding on this surface. We cannot know which citations exist, but we can count how many the site links to. Phrased 'links to N of 8', never 'has N citations'.

social.label: Social presence
social.why: 🔴 Facebook is the #2 local discovery channel (brightlocal_lcrs_2026) — ahead of Yelp. Chris asked for this surface specifically and we currently check NONE of it.

checks.label: Which profiles are LINKED from the site or schema
checks.note: 🔴 Reports NOT LINKED, never NOT EXISTING. Searching platforms by business name returns false matches constantly and a wrong profile is worse than a missing one.

checks.label: NAP on each profile matches GBP
Each linked profile resolves (not a dead page)
checks.note: GET not HEAD — several platforms return 405/999 for HEAD while serving fine. Unreachable is INDETERMINATE, not dead.

checks.label: Last post date per profile
checks.note: A dormant profile ranking for the brand name is worse than none — it signals a dead business.

checks.label: Yelp profile linked
checks.note: Presence only. Yelp rating/review counts need their API or scraping, which we do not do.

ai_discovery.label: AI discovery
ai_discovery.why: 🔴🔴 THE FASTEST-MOVING SURFACE IN LOCAL SEARCH. AI tools went 6% → 45% as a local discovery channel in ONE YEAR and are now #3 overall; ChatGPT 31%, Google AI Mode 23%; 42% trust AI recommendations as much as written reviews — while Google's own discovery share FELL 83% → 71% (brightlocal_lcrs_2026). Nobody audits this yet, including us. Optimising purely for the map pack is optimising for a shrinking share.

checks.label: Does the business surface in AI answers for service + city
checks.note: 🔴🔴 DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT. AI answers are non-deterministic, personalised and differ every run — there is no API that answers this reliably. We measure READINESS (the signals), never PRESENCE (the outcome). Claiming a measured AI-presence metric would be fabricated proof and unfalsifiable to the client. If ever sampled, label it a dated SAMPLE with a run count, never a metric.

checks.label: NAP and services machine-extractable (schema, clean HTML)
checks.note: Checks schema presence, that every JSON-LD block PARSES, that schema NAP matches the GBP, and that the phone is in readable text not only markup.

checks.label: FAQ / Q&A content answering real buyer questions
checks.note: FAQPage/QAPage schema — the single most citable format for answer engines.

checks.label: Consistent presence across sources an AI would cite
checks.note: sameAs links. Without them nothing tells an AI which external profiles are the same business.
